duration: 2 years (Intermediate 1st and 2nd year); public exams (IPE) conducted by TGBIE
leads_to: TG EAPCET (engineering / pharmacy), JEE Main and Advanced, NDA, and other maths-and-science routes

eligibility: Indian national belonging to Telangana (local / non-local status under the Telangana Educational Institutions (Regulation of Admissions) Order, 1974). Passed SSC (BSE Telangana) or an equivalent (CBSE, ICSE, NIOS, TOSS, other state boards) with Mathematics and at least 35% marks; candidates from NIOS/TOSS/CBSE/ICSE/other boards must pass every subject including Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry with at least 35% each. Students awaiting March/April SSC results may apply. No age limit for the test (agricultural / veterinary diplomas have their own age limits)
admission_route: POLYCET conducted by the State Board of Technical Education and Training (SBTET), Telangana: one 2 h 30 min paper, 150 marks (Maths 60, Physics 30, Chemistry 30, Biology 30 - Biology needed only for PJTAU / PVNRTVU / SKLTGHU agricultural, veterinary and horticulture diplomas), then counselling for Government, aided and private polytechnics
application_window: 2026 (closed): online registration 02-02-2026 to 20-04-2026; with late fee to 21-04-2026; Tatkal fee to 22-04-2026. Exam held 13-05-2026 (11:00 AM - 1:30 PM). 2027 notification not yet out
duration: Mostly 3-year diplomas (engineering / non-engineering); PJTAU, PVNRTVU and SKLTGHU diplomas are 2 or 3 years
leads_to: Diploma - jobs in technical / para-engineering roles, or lateral entry to 2nd year B.Tech through TS ECET
source: SBTET Telangana POLYCET-2026 Instruction Booklet (polycet.sbtet.telangana.gov.in/Downloads/polycet2026.pdf: important dates, eligibility 4.0, pattern 7.0), Brief Notification, and POLYCET-2026 Provisional Key notice (exam on 13-05-2026)

eligibility: Indian national, at least 14 years old on 01-08-2026 (16 for Drone Technician), no upper age limit. 10th pass (BSE Telangana, CBSE, ICSE, NIOS, TOSS, APOSS or another state board); some trades accept 8th pass, but 10th-pass candidates get preference
admission_route: One online application at iti.telangana.gov.in for all 65 Advanced Technology Centres (ATCs), 63 Government ITIs and 230 private ITIs (NCVT, Craftsmen Training Scheme). Unlimited district / ITI / trade options. No entrance exam: seats are allotted online on SSC marks, reservation and options, in phases followed by walk-in admissions
application_window: 2026-27 session (August 2026): four online phases, then a 5th-phase walk-in notified 12-10-2026 - walk-in admissions open from 10-10-2026 (register online first; walk-ins before 1 PM are considered the same day)
duration: 47 trades in all: 6 in ATCs (3 two-year, 3 one-year) and 41 CTS trades in ITIs (32 engineering, 15 non-engineering; 21 two-year and 26 one-year). Trade-wise duration in Annexure-II of the prospectus
leads_to: National Trade Certificate (NCVT) after the All India Trade Test; apprenticeship, jobs or self-employment
source: Department of Employment and Training, Telangana - TG ITI Admissions 2026 Prospectus (iti.telangana.gov.in/assets/pdf2026/Prospectus_2026.pdf, sections 1, 5-7) and 5th Phase / Walk-in Admission Notification No. I-1/Admissions 2026/2026 dated 12-10-2026

pathway_name: Continuation at a Telangana state residential school/society (TSWREIS/TTWREIS/MJPTBCWREIS/TREIS, EMRS, TMS, TMREIS) into Class 11-12 (Intermediate)
eligibility: Must have passed Class 10/SSC; typically drawn from (but not limited to) students already enrolled in the corresponding welfare society's own school network, subject to that society's caste/tribe/BC/minority-category eligibility (or EMRS's ST-focused criteria); residential junior colleges commonly set an age-limit (around 17 years as of 31 August of the admission year) and a parental-income ceiling (commonly around Rs. 2,00,000/year) - exact figures vary by society and year
admission_route: Conflicting/evolving picture across sources: a Dec-2024 Telangana Today report said TGSWREIS decided to admit its own Class X pass-outs into Intermediate 1st year WITHOUT an entrance exam starting the following year, allotting seats by SSC GPA so seats would not sit vacant; however a dedicated Common Entrance Test (TGSWRJC CET for TSWREIS, TGTWRJC CET for TTWREIS, TGMRJC CET/TGMRCOE CET for TMREIS, or the general TGRJC CET for Centre-of-Excellence junior colleges) was still conducted for the 2026-27 cycle (TGSWRJC CET held 15-May-2026, with a district-level spot-counselling round on 6-Jul-2026 for leftover seats). The no-CET/GPA-based route and the CET route therefore appear to coexist as of the 2026-27 cycle - possibly applying to different seat categories (e.g. the society's own Class-X pass-outs vs external applicants) rather than one having replaced the other - unverified - needs follow-up directly against tgswreis.telangana.gov.in (not reached via search) to confirm which mechanism governs which seats.
application_window: Typically March-July for the following academic year's Intermediate 1st-year intake (e.g. TGSWRJC CET 2026 held 15-May-2026, spot counselling 6-Jul-2026); exact dates vary by society and year - confirm via each society's own site for the current cycle
duration: 2 years (Intermediate 1st and 2nd year, Classes 11-12)
leads_to: TG EAPCET and other entrance exams for engineering/medical/other professional degree admission, or direct employment-oriented pathways, same as any other Intermediate-pass student in Telangana
source: Telangana Today, 'TSWREIS junior colleges' tag page incl. Dec-2024 no-entrance-exam/SSC-GPA report; collegeadmission.in TGSWRJC CET 2026 notice; Deccan Chronicle, 'TGSWREIS to Conduct Spot Counselling For Inter First-Year Vacant Seats' (2026) - unverified - needs follow-up on which seat category each admission route governs

pathway_name: PUC Science - PCMB (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology)
eligibility: Passed Karnataka SSLC (Class 10) or an equivalent exam from a COBSE-listed board
admission_route: Apply directly to a Pre-University college; there is no state entrance test. Students passing Karnataka SSLC (or an equivalent exam of a COBSE-listed board) are eligible. Students from CBSE / ICSE / other boards or other states first get a provisional eligibility certificate online on the PU portal (pue.karnataka.gov.in), which the college verifies before admitting. Colleges may admit only to the languages and combinations the Department has sanctioned for them, at most 80 students per section, and enter every admission on the SATS portal
application_window: 2026-27 cycle (closed): 1st PUC admissions opened 24-04-2026; without penalty until 30-06-2026; with a Rs.670 late fee 01-07-2026 to 10-07-2026; with a special penalty (Rs.2,220 + Rs.670) 11-07-2026 to 30-07-2026. Classes began 25-05-2026. The Department later issued a circular extending the 1st PUC admission date (see pue.karnataka.gov.in recent circulars). 2027-28 dates not yet announced
duration: 2 years (1st PUC + 2nd PUC, Classes 11-12). Each student takes 2 languages (Part 1) and one combination of 4 elective subjects (Part 2)
leads_to: 2nd PUC board exam (KSEAB) in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology - the combination that keeps open KCET for Engineering, Farm Science and B.Pharm and NEET-UG for Medicine. PCMB is one of the 6 Science combinations the Department has approved (codes 33 34 35 36)
source: Department of School Education (Pre-University), Karnataka - Guidelines 2026-27 (Margasuchi), pue.karnataka.gov.in/uploads/guidelines_2026-27_1780740642.pdf: Chapter 1 admission calendar (p.2), Chapter 2 languages, electives and the approved subject combinations (pp.4-5), Chapter 3 1st PUC admission rules (pp.6-8)

pathway_name: PUC Commerce - EBAS (Economics, Business Studies, Accountancy, Statistics)
eligibility: Passed Karnataka SSLC (Class 10) or an equivalent exam from a COBSE-listed board
admission_route: Apply directly to a Pre-University college; there is no state entrance test. Students passing Karnataka SSLC (or an equivalent exam of a COBSE-listed board) are eligible. Students from CBSE / ICSE / other boards or other states first get a provisional eligibility certificate online on the PU portal (pue.karnataka.gov.in), which the college verifies before admitting. Colleges may admit only to the languages and combinations the Department has sanctioned for them, at most 80 students per section, and enter every admission on the SATS portal
application_window: 2026-27 cycle (closed): 1st PUC admissions opened 24-04-2026; without penalty until 30-06-2026; with a Rs.670 late fee 01-07-2026 to 10-07-2026; with a special penalty (Rs.2,220 + Rs.670) 11-07-2026 to 30-07-2026. Classes began 25-05-2026. The Department later issued a circular extending the 1st PUC admission date (see pue.karnataka.gov.in recent circulars). 2027-28 dates not yet announced
duration: 2 years (1st PUC + 2nd PUC, Classes 11-12). Each student takes 2 languages (Part 1) and one combination of 4 elective subjects (Part 2)
leads_to: 2nd PUC board exam (KSEAB) in Economics, Business Studies, Accountancy and Statistics, then B.Com / Economics / Statistics degrees and CA-CS-CMA Foundation routes. One of the 9 approved Commerce combinations (codes 22 27 30 31)

pathway_name: Karnataka Polytechnic Diploma - Merit-based (SSLC marks) via DTE Karnataka
eligibility: Karnataka candidates only. Indian citizen who passed Karnataka SSLC or an equivalent exam; for engineering diploma courses at least 35% overall in SSLC
admission_route: No entrance exam (Karnataka has no POLYCET). For Government and aided polytechnics, download the application form and priority sheet from dtek.karnataka.gov.in / dtetech.karnataka.gov.in and submit it to the principal of any nearby Government polytechnic (or Code-1 aided polytechnic). Seats are then allotted online on SSLC-marks merit and reservation; seats left after allotment are filled offline at the polytechnic. Private polytechnics admit separately. Note: DCET (KEA) is a different exam, for diploma holders entering B.E. 2nd year
application_window: 2026-27 cycle (closed): forms submitted 21-04-2026 to 16-05-2026; provisional merit list 16-05-2026, final merit list 18-05-2026, seat allotment 22-05-2026, admission 23-05-2026 to 25-05-2026, leftover seats filled offline 26-05-2026 to 30-05-2026. 2027-28 dates not yet announced
duration: Diploma (1st semester entry); engineering and non-engineering programmes
leads_to: Diploma - employment, or lateral entry to 2nd year B.E. through KEA's DCET
source: Department of Technical Education, Karnataka - 1st Semester Diploma Engineering & Non-Engineering Admission 2026-27 e-Information Brochure (dtetech.karnataka.gov.in/kartechnical/Files/DIP_ADMN_BROCHURE.pdf, admission process and schedule p.4) and DTE admission overview page (dtek.karnataka.gov.in/48/admission-overview: eligibility, 35% SSLC for engineering courses)

eligibility: At least 14 years old on 01-08-2026. Indian citizen who studied at least 5 years between Classes 1 and 10 in recognised schools in Karnataka (exceptions for children of Central / State government employees posted in Karnataka, and Horanadu/Gadinadu Kannadigas). Most trades need a Class 10 pass (SSLC / KOS / CBSE / ICSE / NIOS or a COBSE-recognised board); Carpenter, Sheet Metal Worker, Welder, Wireman, Mason, Painter and Plumber also accept Class 8 pass or SSLC fail
admission_route: No entrance exam. Apply online at cite.karnataka.gov.in (Commissionerate of Industrial Training and Employment), choosing 1-20 trade/ITI options; free help desks at every ITI. Seats in 270 Government and 192 aided private ITIs (NCVT-affiliated units only) are allotted on merit and reservation in online rounds, then a casual round. Documents are verified at a Government ITI of the candidate's choice (Rs.50 fee)
application_window: 2026 (August session, closed): online applications 27-04-2026 to 08-05-2026 (notification dated 24-04-2026); casual-round notification issued 27-05-2026. 2027 dates not yet announced
duration: Set by DGT per trade (NCVT); see the trade list on cite.karnataka.gov.in
leads_to: National Trade Certificate (NCVT) on passing the trade exam, then apprenticeship, skilled-trade jobs or further study
source: Commissionerate of Industrial Training and Employment, Karnataka - ITI admission notification for Government and aided ITIs, August 2026 session, dated 24-04-2026 (cite.karnataka.gov.in > Admission Notification, DITE/TRG/TRG-1/CR1/2026-2027/1); casual-round notification 2026-2027/2 dated 27-05-2026

eligibility: Same as Engineering trades: at least 14 on 01-08-2026, 5 years of schooling in Karnataka (with the listed exceptions). Most trades need a Class 10 pass; Dress Making, Sewing Technology and Surface Ornamentation Technique also accept Class 8 pass or SSLC fail
admission_route: Same single online process as Engineering trades at cite.karnataka.gov.in: merit-and-reservation online seat allotment across Government and aided ITIs, no entrance exam
application_window: 2026 (August session, closed): online applications 27-04-2026 to 08-05-2026; casual round notified 27-05-2026. 2027 dates not yet announced
duration: Set by DGT per trade (NCVT); see the trade list on cite.karnataka.gov.in
leads_to: National Trade Certificate (NCVT) - self-employment, apprenticeship or jobs in the trade
source: Commissionerate of Industrial Training and Employment, Karnataka - ITI admission notification dated 24-04-2026 (cite.karnataka.gov.in, DITE/TRG/TRG-1/CR1/2026-2027/1)

eligibility: Passed Secondary (Class 10) from a recognised board; at least 15 years old (on 31-07-2026 for Block 1, on 31-01-2027 for Block 2). No upper age limit
admission_route: Online admission at sdmis.nios.ac.in (NIOS, Ministry of Education). Karnataka is served by the NIOS Regional Centre Bengaluru (RC 17); learners pick a study centre (Accredited Institution) while applying
application_window: 2026-27 (Stream 1): Block 1 - 16-03-2026 to 31-07-2026 without late fee, then late-fee windows to 15-09-2026 (first exam March-April 2027). Block 2 - 16-09-2026 to 31-01-2027 without late fee, then late-fee windows (Rs.260 / 520 / 910) to 15-03-2027 (first exam September-October 2027). Fee for 5 subjects: Rs.2,600 (male), Rs.2,150 (female / third gender), Rs.1,690 (SC/ST, ex-servicemen, PwD)
duration: Admission is valid for five years, with public exams twice a year
leads_to: NIOS Senior Secondary certificate, accepted for degree admission and entrance exams like any Class 12 pass
source: NIOS Academic Prospectus 2026-27 (sdmis.nios.ac.in > Prospectus 2026-27: admission blocks p.21, entry requirements Table 3, fee Table 4) and NIOS Regional Centre list (nios.ac.in/about-us/regional-centre-website.aspx)

pathway_name: Continuation at a Karnataka state residential institution (KREIS/Sainik/RMS/JNV) into PUC (Class 11-12)
eligibility: Already enrolled through Class 10 at a Karnataka-based JNV, Sainik School, Rashtriya Military School (RMS), or a KREIS (Morarji Desai Residential School / affiliated society) institution
admission_route: Students at these Central/State residential networks typically continue into Class 11-12 (PUC) either at an attached Pre-University section of the same institution or by transferring to an external PU college, following the same Science/Commerce/Arts stream-combination system documented above - mirrors the equivalent AP/Telangana continuation rows. Karnataka-specific confirmation of which of these four networks run their own attached PU sections versus routinely sending students externally was NOT independently verified this session
application_window: Not applicable (internal continuation, not a fresh public application cycle) - exact internal process/cutoff (if any) not independently verified
duration: 2 years (Class 11-12 / 1st & 2nd PUC)
leads_to: Karnataka 2nd PUC Board Exam in the chosen stream, then the same entrance-exam routes (KCET, NEET-UG, JEE Main, CUET-UG, NDA, etc.) as other Karnataka PUC-pass students
source: General knowledge of JNV/Sainik/RMS all-India policy of running integrated schooling through Class 12 at a majority of their campuses, combined with the Karnataka-specific school rows added 2026-10-28/29 (JNV, Sainik School, RMS, KREIS Residential Schools) - Karnataka-specific confirmation of attached-PU-section status not independently found this session; flagged unverified, needs follow-up directly with NVS/Sainik Schools Society/KREIS
